newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha prices rise to highest in four years.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha prices rise to highest in four years.

text.p: Tokyo naphtha prices reached their highest level in four years in Wednesday afternoon trade, supported by bullish northwest European markets as well as a crude rally overnight, traders said.
Open-spec naphtha for second-half November was offered at $210.00, while bids were assessed at $208.75. The previous high was $207.00/$208.00 marked earlier this month.
Bids for first-half December were heard at $208.75, with offers at $209.50. It was traded at $206.00 on Tuesday.
The one-month naphtha spread from second-half November was discussed at plus 75 cents/$1.00.
